name: chrome-extension-template
author: Farooq Hussain M
description: A modern Chrome extension template with comprehensive tooling

scripts.prebuild:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=dev npm run ensure-pem && cross-env NODE_ENV=dev node scripts/generate-manifest.js
scripts.prebuild:uat: cross-env NODE_ENV=uat npm run ensure-pem && cross-env NODE_ENV=uat node scripts/generate-manifest.js
scripts.prebuild:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=prod npm run ensure-pem && cross-env NODE_ENV=prod node scripts/generate-manifest.js
scripts.build:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=dev vite build --config vite/vite.dev.config.mjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=dev vite build --config vite/vite.background.config.mjs --mode development && cross-env NODE_ENV=dev vite build --config vite/vite.content.config.mjs --mode development && cross-env NODE_ENV=dev node scripts/post-build-package.js
scripts.build:uat: cross-env NODE_ENV=uat vite build --config vite/vite.uat.config.mjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=uat vite build --config vite/vite.background.config.mjs --mode uat && cross-env NODE_ENV=uat vite build --config vite/vite.content.config.mjs --mode uat && cross-env NODE_ENV=uat node scripts/post-build-package.js
scripts.build:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=prod vite build --config vite/vite.prod.config.mjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=prod vite build --config vite/vite.background.config.mjs --mode production && cross-env NODE_ENV=prod vite build --config vite/vite.content.config.mjs --mode production && cross-env NODE_ENV=prod node scripts/post-build-package.js
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:check && npm run test:unit
